newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Ent to issue shares for over-allotment.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Ent to issue shares for over-allotment.

text.p: Beijing Enterprises Holdings Ltd will issue an additional 22.5 million new shares to cover over-allotment, a source at Peregrine Capital Ltd said on Thursday.
Peregrine Capital was one of the global coordinators of Beijing Enterprises' global initial public offering of 150 million shares.
The Hong Kong portion was 1,276 times subscribed -- the highest level ever in the territory.
Beijing Enrterprises shares ended their first day of trading on Thursday at HK$40.20, compared with an issue price of HK$12.48.
